messages.content: 尋找Netflix上《六人行》的電視節目列表及其評分，以及Hulu上《我們的辦公室》和《怪奇物語》的評分，並按照評分排序。

function.name: streaming_services_shows_list_and_ratings
function.description: Get a list of shows and their ratings on specific streaming services. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

streaming_service.description: Name of the streaming service. E.g., Netflix, Hulu, etc.

show_list.description: List of show names to search for on the platform.

sort_by_rating.description: If set to true, returns the list sorted by ratings. Defaults to false.

message.reasoning:
The user wants to find Netflix shows list and ratings for "Six Feet Under" (assuming that's the show). Also Hulu ratings for "Our Office" (maybe "Our Office" is "Our Office"? Might be "Our Office" but maybe it's "Our Office" or "Our Office"? Actually "Our Office" might be "Our Office" but I'm not sure. The user also wants "Stranger Things" rating. They want sorted by rating.

We need to call the function streaming_services_shows_list_and_ratings with appropriate arguments. For Netflix: streaming_service="Netflix", show_list=["Six Feet Under"], sort_by_rating=true. For Hulu: streaming_service="Hulu", show_list=["Our Office","Stranger Things"], sort_by_rating=true.

But we need to combine? The function can only handle one streaming service at a time. So we need to call twice. But the user wants combined results sorted by rating. We can call twice and then combine results. But the function returns list sorted by rating if requested. So we can call each separately with sort_by_rating=true. Then combine the lists. But the user wants sorted by rating across all shows? They didn't specify cross-service sorting. They said "and according to rating". That could mean each list sorted by rating. Or overall sorted. We'll interpret as each list sorted by rating. So we can call twice.

Let's do first call: streaming_service="Netflix", show_list=["Six Feet Under"], sort_by_rating=true. Then second call: streaming_service="Hulu", show_list=["Our Office","Stranger Things"], sort_by_rating=true.

We'll produce two calls.
